course_review/1.card_source: AllSquare Golf (allsquaregolf.com/golf-courses/illinois/tpc-deere-run), fetched 2026-10-30; golfify 404, GolfPass 403, BlueGolf 405
course_notes: No web card in the build: the page solved 'osm_back' = OSM tee nearest the hole-line start, which is a mix: holes 2, 4, 5, 6 play from behind the Gold tee, holes 7-18 from forward (Blue/White) tees, 60-111 yds short on 8-15, 17, 18. Page total 6,437 'back' yds is not any real set.
Pars on the page (35-36 = 71) match the card on all 18 holes. Routing and greens match the imagery on all 18 holes (18: lake left of the green with the grandstands; 16: short par 3).

Fix: rebuild with request "scorecard": "course_data/library/tpc_deere_run/card_review.json" (scorecard/1, all 5 sets), tees ["Gold", "Black"]. No osm_supplement needed: OSM maps 65 tees, the build just had no yardages to pick them.
